## Result

- Skill: proposal-review
- Review status: approved
- Vision alignment: aligned
- Material findings: none
- Open substantive blockers: none
- Proposal readiness: sufficient direction for authorized Design; reliance requires successful durable recording of this assessment.
- Immediate next stage: isolated stop.
- Automatic downstream handoff: none.
- Claim limitations: direction approval only; no detailed Design, Delivery, implementation, verification, publication, or customer-adoption approval.

Exact subject: `docs/proposals/2026-09-08-skill-model-proposal-family-pilot.md`.

Reviewed raw-byte SHA-256: `bbe68d1c42741d22bc6349cc736b1a862ddec936a2e65bc16b079b7ef9847808`.

Reviewer: independent proposal-review agent `/root/independent_proposal_review`. The submitted direction was supplied by the user; the proposal artifact was authored by the parent agent, which also added its owning-change pointer. This reviewer did not author either contribution and made no edits to the proposal. The reviewer read the complete final proposal, including the pointer, against the original user direction and repository authority. Actual contributor separation establishes independence; a role label alone does not.

## Review Dimensions

| Dimension | Judgment | Rationale |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Challenge | pass | Fragmented ownership and document-only versus inventory-wide refactor risks are material and precede the solution. System's responsibility inventory confirms the unmigrated skill/resource owner. |
| Goals | pass | Coherent ownership, demonstrated two-skill improvement, readable history and named later adoption address the challenge without savings quotas. |
| Scope | pass | Exact pilot names, common extraction, compatibility limits, exclusions and follow-up ownership prevent silent expansion or narrowing. |
| Governing principle | pass | Brief, sound and independent of implementation mechanisms. |
| Direction | pass | Distinguishes preserved obligations, pilot-only improvements and elsewhere-owned policy; requires inspected baseline, substantive disposition and bounded coexistence. |
| Feasibility | pass | Exactly one embedded assessment provides existing contract/pilot evidence, discloses unassessed dependencies and improvements, and identifies potential blockers for dependent adoption or closeout. |
| Material impact | pass | Temporary adoption differences, historical preservation, shared-dependency compatibility and limited pilot generalizability are disclosed. |
| Vision alignment | pass | Durable ownership, readable evidence, explicit follow-up and independent judgments support inspectable, resumable and traceable work. |
| Downstream authority | pass | Exact clauses, improvements, source moves/removals, requirements and proof allocation remain with Design, Delivery and independent assessment. Representative outcomes bound direction without prescribing implementation or tests. |
| Requested decision | pass | Establishes the model and named pilot, conditional retirement and closure with later adoption assigned; withholds implementation and operational activation authority. |

## Scope Preservation Review

- Scope-preservation result: pass.

All material initial goals remain: one Skill owner; the proposal/proposal-review pilot; specialist policy, governed recording and isolated invocation preservation; existing improvements as baseline; explicit pilot/non-pilot applicability; resource integrity and compatibility; useful readable archive with historical identities; no blanket removals or test deletion; currently applicable proof policy; useful demonstrated improvement; named later adoption; independent reviews and distinct Verify. The scope budget classifies core work, same-slice dependencies, deferred adoption, separate initiatives and exclusions. The repository maintainer receives remaining adoption through existing follow-up records, with families, differences and next adoption decision identified before closeout. No goal disappears or silently expands.

## Recommended Proposal Edits

- Recommended edits: none required.

## Recommendation

- Recommendation: approve the direction; record this exact independent assessment and stop after the isolated review.

Unknown concrete pilot edits and source/dependency dispositions properly remain Design work. The proposal neither claims current defects nor completed adoption and requires an unfavorable or inconclusive pilot result to be dispositioned.

Evidence inspected: complete proposal and original user direction; CONSTITUTION.md ownership, precedence, isolation and review rules; VISION.md; System responsibility inventory; Skill Contract ownership amendments, common scope, proposal-stage contract and prospective proof disposition; Skill Readability Goal and context; Proposal-Family Assets Progressive Disclosure Goal and context; Published Skill Resource Integrity ADR Context and Decision; Design DES-SR-02/06/13/14/18/19 and related consumer boundaries. Following the Skill Contract proof reference, inspected published-skill-first-repository-simplification R24-R29 to confirm current restrictions and preserved deterministic proof. Bounded canonical proposal and proposal-review skill inspection confirms complementary invocation descriptions, resource maps and authority boundaries. This is not a full pilot conformance audit or snapshot-byte comparison.

Read required proposal-review assessment, reliance, conditional gates, recording, requirement-refinement guidance and result asset. Read-only cat, sed, rg and sha256sum inspections were performed; no executable behavior or package conformance is claimed. The final subject was fully reread after the author added its owning-change pointer; that pointer introduces no substantive direction change, and the judgment applies to the final identity above.
